attempt_journal.name: acquisition_attempt_journal
attempt_journal.role: fsync'd, write-once (append-only framed records), restart-authoritative LOCAL control evidence for acquisition attempts. It is local control evidence only: never a QFAR1 member, never inside the capture root, never the public anchor.
attempt_journal.semantics: before each request, an fsync'd attempt record is appended; a symbol with an attempt record but no final raw file is ATTEMPT_CONSUMED_AMBIGUOUS — never blindly re-requested on restart; it HOLDs for adjudication. On restart: final file + hash match = SKIP_VERIFIED; final mismatch = HOLD:FINAL_MISMATCH. (Rule preserved from rev2; relocated outside the capture root per -18 r2 because the accepted publisher rejects any capture-root entry outside the membership set.)

archive.control_directory: ~/workspace/data_archive/yahoo_1h_clean/<capture_id>.control/ — a strict-capture-ID sibling of archive.root, OUTSIDE the capture root. It holds exactly the two local control journals (archive.ledger_objects.acquisition_attempt_journal and archive.ledger_objects.qfj2_publication_journal), kept as separate files. Nothing in the control directory is a QFAR1 member.
archive.durability: provided by the designated private GitHub repo mickaellall116-cmyk/qf-data-archive (Mike's storage designation, 2026-10-15): append-only, write-once captures, checksum-verified by re-fetch. The rev2-era local-volume durability question is superseded — the local staging copy is not a durability claim and its loss before publication is a failed capture, not a data-loss event.

meta/<SYMBOL>.request.json (request params, config, runtime pins, acquisition UTC timestamp, source=yahoo/yfinance)
manifest.json (this manifest + per-file sha256 + acquisition ledger)

membership contract: the capture root contains ONLY the entries above — raw/, actions/, meta/ plus canonical manifest.json and SHA256SUMS; any other capture-root entry fails the publisher census with HOLD:MEMBERSHIP

NOT capture-root entries, NOT QFAR1 members: acquisition_attempt_journal and qfj2_publication_journal (both live in archive.control_directory), and the public_archive_anchor (created only in the public scanner repo, after final verification)

public_archive_anchor.name: public_archive_anchor
public_archive_anchor.role: hashes/identifiers only; created ONLY after final remote verification succeeds (publication_binding.final_verification steps 1-4). Later consumers start from this anchor and independently re-verify the referenced commit/blob/container/members; no branch-tip-only trust. The anchor is an output of verification, never an input to it; not a QFAR1 member and not part of the 67,108,864-byte ceiling The anchor is SELF-SUFFICIENT for a later consumer: given only the anchor bytes and the designated repo's objects, the consumer re-verifies the exact commit/tree/blob, recomputes the container pin, checks all 158 members against the carried sealed pin map and the 156-payload projection against the carried independent pin map; the two canonical pin-map digests make any pin-map alteration detectable. No local journals, publisher process state or out-of-band pins are required; no branch-tip trust.

qfj2_publication_journal.role: the accepted publisher's QFJ2 intent/published journal (publisher pin 53bdc672e609791dc55277023dd984cd8727f3c3): the intent record pins parent, CONTAINER_SHA256, blob id and member pins before any remote write; the published record pins the exact commit and verification transcript. archive.membership_contract: capture-root membership is exactly raw/, actions/, meta/, plus optional canonical manifest.json and SHA256SUMS; QFAR1 seals exactly 156 payloads + 2 bookkeeping members = 158. No control journal (acquisition or publication) and no public anchor is a QFAR1 member, and none is part of the 67,108,864-byte physical-member ceiling.
archive.publication: QFAR1 single-blob publication ONLY (see publication_binding): the 158 physical members (156 payloads + manifest.json + SHA256SUMS) are sealed into one deterministic QFAR1 container and published by the accepted publisher pin to the designated private repo as one commit at captures/<capture_id>.qfar. The rev2 per-file os.link publication narrative is superseded and forbidden. Publication is complete only after final commit/blob/container/member verification passes against the independent validation pins.
archive.restart: final files are hash-verified and skipped (never re-requested, never overwritten); collision on an existing final path = WRITE_ONCE_COLLISION, stop
archive.rollback: archive is additive and write-once; nothing in live state is touched, so rollback = abandon the capture dir (retained as evidence, marked INCOMPLETE); no deletion of prior captures ever
archive.root: local staging only (transient working state, NOT the archive of record): ~/workspace/data_archive/yahoo_1h_clean/<capture_id>/ — staged members are sealed into one QFAR1 container and published to the designated private repo per publication_binding; durability comes from that repo, never from this volume. Control files never live at or under this root: the capture root contains exactly the membership set in archive.layout / archive.membership_contract, and both control journals live in the sibling control directory (archive.control_directory).

stages: 1) clean capture executor: a future, separately authorized executor written fresh against this manifest; it stages the 156 payloads under archive.root; its acquisition_attempt_journal lives in the sibling control directory (archive.control_directory), never inside the capture root

2) independent validation: qualification gates G1-G11 run against the staged members and produce the independent validation pins (the per-member sha256 set) — pins originate from the validator, never from the capture process's own claims

3) accepted publisher: publication exclusively by the accepted QFAR1 publisher (pin 53bdc672e609791dc55277023dd984cd8727f3c3) bound in publication_binding, consuming the validation pins; the publisher's qfj2_publication_journal also lives in the control directory, outside the capture root

4) public anchor: only after the publisher's final remote verification passes, the hashes-only public_archive_anchor is recorded in the public scanner repo at research_notes/archive_anchors/<capture_id>.json; consumers start from the anchor and re-verify

execution_packet.note: This candidate authorizes none of these stages; adoption of this manifest is itself a separate act that has not occurred. The rev2 later_command (parked-executor route) is removed, not replaced with another command.

final_verification: resolve the exact published commit by its pinned SHA from the qfj2_publication_journal published record (never a branch tip)

fetch the blob by its exact pinned blob id and recompute CONTAINER_SHA256 from the fetched bytes; it must equal the container pin — the CONTAINER_SHA256 sealed in the QFJ2 intent record (publication_binding.pin_domains.container_pin). The container pin is compared ONLY to that sealed value, never to either pin map. The public anchor does not exist yet at this step and is never an input to verification

parse the container and verify all 158 members against the sealed member pins (QFJ2 intent record): member set, lengths and SHA-256 equal the sealed 158 set exactly; then verify the 156-payload projection of the parsed members equals the independent validation pins exactly. The independent pins are never compared against the two bookkeeping members or the container digest
verify the ref still resolves to the pinned commit and that commit/tree/blob ids equal the intent/published records, or fetch the commit directly by id

only after steps 1-4 pass: create the public_archive_anchor (archive.ledger_objects.public_archive_anchor) in the public scanner repo at research_notes/archive_anchors/<capture_id>.json; partial states (objects without ref update, ref update without verification, verification without anchor) are no-publication

member_accounting.binding_graph: manifest.json binds the 156 payloads only; SHA256SUMS binds exactly 157 (156 payloads + manifest.json), never itself; the QFAR1 index binds all 158; the container trailer digest + git blob id bind the whole container (acyclic, per design r3)

container_pin.excludes: membership in either pin map; it is never an element of, or compared against, a pin map
container_pin.form: one sha256 (hex) — CONTAINER_SHA256, the trailer digest (SHA-256 over all container bytes preceding the 32-byte trailer)
container_pin.produced: publisher-derived at build time and sealed in the QFJ2 intent record; verified ONLY by recomputation from the exact fetched blob bytes

independent_validation_pins.excludes: the two bookkeeping members (manifest.json, SHA256SUMS) and the container digest
independent_validation_pins.produced: computed from the capture's payload bytes by the independent validator BEFORE publication; the _require_pins input to the publisher; never derived from the container

pin_domains.non_substitution_rule: the three domains are disjoint in scope and are never substituted for one another: the container pin is compared only to the sealed intent value; the sealed 158 set is compared only to parsed container members; the independent 156 set is compared only to the payload projection of the parsed members

sealed_member_pins.produced: sealed by the publisher into the QFJ2 intent record at container build time
sealed_member_pins.projection_rule: the 156-payload projection of the sealed set MUST equal independent_validation_pins exactly; the two bookkeeping entries are canonical under the acyclic binding graph (manifest.json binds the 156 payloads only; SHA256SUMS binds exactly 157)
sealed_member_pins.scope: exactly the 158 physical members (156 payloads + manifest.json + SHA256SUMS)

qualification_gates_frozen: G1 completeness: 52/52 symbols accounted — qualified, COVERAGE-LIMITED, or HOLD with named cause; zero silent exclusions

G2 coverage: sessions present / XNYS sessions in window per symbol; <80% of window sessions = COVERAGE-LIMITED (counted, retained, flagged — not dropped); listing-age exceptions only where first-trade date is evidenced in actions/meta
G3 integrity: duplicate timestamps = 0, nonmonotonic rows = 0 (any occurrence = HOLD)
G4 sessions: missing expected sessions/bars enumerated per symbol vs XNYS calendar; unexplained gaps = HOLD
G5 OHLCV sanity: High>=max(Open,Close), Low<=min(Open,Close), Volume>=0; any violation = HOLD
G6 timezone/DST: bar labels on DST transition weeks exactly 09:30/13:30 ET with correct UTC offsets; any UTC-anchored label = HOLD (the D1 defect class)
G7 early close: known early-close dates emit exactly one 09:30 bar aggregating the 4 morning 1H rows
G8 actions: split/dividend rows reconciled against the frozen split-exclusion protocol; unhandled split inside window = HOLD for that symbol
G9 conservation: raw->4H per-bar aggregation recomputed independently; volume sums and first/last OHLC match exactly
G10 two-window parity: bars built from a short window and from the full window are byte-identical on the overlap, across a DST boundary
G11 hash stability: re-hash of the archive equals manifest SHA256SUMS exactly; any drift = HOLD
